c01s03.title: Observation and motive
c01s03.caption: One behaviour can fit several motivational accounts.

c01s03b.title: Map the actual choice
c01s03b.caption: Motivation operates within real opportunities and limits.

c01s04.title: Investigate rather than label
c01s04.caption: A motive is a hypothesis constrained by evidence.

c01s05.title: A motivational explanation
c01s05.caption: Avoid treating a behaviour as a complete character assessment.

c02s03.title: A simplified regulatory model
c02s03.caption: The model illustrates one influence rather than a complete explanation.

c02s03b.title: Different sources of influence
c02s03b.caption: The influences can interact rather than compete as exclusive explanations.

c02s04.title: Interpret a choice carefully
c02s04.caption: One observed choice does not uniquely identify its cause.

c02s05.title: Several influences on action
c02s05.caption: A multilevel explanation can accommodate more than one influence.

c03s03.title: Two separate questions
c03s03.caption: High value does not guarantee high expectancy or low cost.

c03s03b.title: Build an evidence-based expectation
c03s03b.caption: Capability beliefs should be interpreted against specific tasks and evidence.

c03s04.title: A practical motivational check
c03s04.caption: A useful plan addresses actual beliefs and conditions.

c03s05.title: A choice is more than interest
c03s05.caption: Different barriers call for different supports.

c04s03.title: Three different experiences
c04s03.caption: These theoretical constructs are related but not interchangeable.

c04s03b.title: Freedom and usable support
c04s03b.caption: Autonomy support can include structure without coercion.

c04s04.title: Different reasons for action
c04s04.caption: Extrinsic motivation is not one uniform kind of pressure.

c04s05.title: Evaluate the motivational setting
c04s05.caption: Support concerns the quality of conditions, not a motivational slogan.

c05s03.title: Different goals
c05s03.caption: The useful target depends on task complexity and current skill.

c05s03b.title: Connect the goal to the action
c05s03b.caption: The process should serve the meaningful outcome.

c05s04.title: Evaluate the goal
items: What evidence would change the plan?
c05s04.caption: A target is a tool for action, not a reason to ignore harm.

c05s05.title: A useful goal-setting test
c05s05.caption: More effort is not always the right response to a badly specified goal.

c06s03.title: One option, two anticipated outcomes
c06s03.caption: Conflicting motives can operate at the same time.

c06s03b.title: Understand the pattern
c06s03b.caption: The same action may be protective or restrictive in different conditions.

c06s04.title: A respectful response
c06s04.caption: Support can alter the route without denying the conflict.

c06s05.title: Evaluate the conflict
c06s05.caption: Avoidance is interpreted through its function and consequences.

c07s03.title: Different emotion measures
c07s03.caption: One component does not uniquely identify all the others.

c07s03b.title: Different theoretical questions
c07s03b.caption: Theories need suitable tests beyond a plausible everyday anecdote.

c07s04.title: Same event, different significance
c07s04.caption: The appraisals are hypotheses, not a reading of someone’s mind.

c07s05.title: Read an emotion claim
c07s05.caption: Emotional understanding uses several sources rather than one cue.

c08s03.title: Several possible points of action
c08s03.caption: The sequence is a useful framework, not one universal prescription.

c08s03b.title: Different targets
c08s03b.caption: A strategy’s consequences depend on its purpose and context.

c08s04.title: Choose a proportionate strategy
c08s04.caption: Regulation should fit the problem rather than erase emotional information.

c08s05.title: A regulation decision
items: Does it serve the actual goal?
c08s05.caption: The best choice is conditional rather than a universal slogan.

c09s03.title: Different evaluations
c09s03.caption: The distinction is conceptual and does not diagnose a person’s state.

c09s03b.title: Interpret expression carefully
c09s03b.caption: Group-level patterns do not identify an individual’s feeling.

c09s04.title: From inference to support
c09s04.caption: Care does not require certainty about another person’s internal state.

c09s05.title: A social-emotion interpretation
c09s05.caption: Understanding improves when interpretations remain revisable.

c10s03.title: Different outcomes
c10s03.caption: An enthusiastic reaction does not establish lasting benefit.

c10s03b.title: Evaluate the promise
c10s03b.caption: Practical claims require evidence for their actual scope.

c10s04.title: A final recommendation
c10s04.caption: Useful support can remain modest and open to revision.

c10s05.title: A credible motivational claim
items: Whom does it help, with what limits?
c10s05.caption: Good intentions and vivid testimonials do not settle efficacy.
